why: Company release of 2026-09-10 sets Q3 2026 results for 2026-11-30 before the open, video call 08:30 ET. Baseline history is 6-K-matched and includes order-announcement days (2026-07-17, 09-30, 10-20) that are not prints.
session_evidence: Release says results before market open on 2026-11-30, call 8:30 a.m. ET (https://finviz.com/news/390870/bos-to-release-third-quarter-2026-results-on-november-30-2026)

USD/ILS in Q3 2026: the CFO quantified a $0.6m H1 opex hit from shekel strength, so the Q3 currency move is a direct margin input
Israeli defense customer budgets and timing (the customer of the 2026-10-01 follow-on order)
Whether the guide is reiterated or raised again, since that line moved the last print
